profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at WP Engine
profile.summary: Software developer with experience designing and implementing full-stack solutions including database, back-end, APIs and front-end. Experienced writing unit and integration tests for each piece of the stack.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a system of C# microservices that utilized RESTful APIs, message queues, and gRPC to improve device health system and expand device coverage. Some of these services required API integrations to third-party providers such as Verizon, AT&T, Jasper, AWS, and Nexmo over REST and SOAP protocols for SMS communication.

• Developed web tools to provide access to device health data and action commands using latest Angular framework and C#. Collaborated in component library with over 15 Angular components to streamline future development. Created various NPM packages for each Angular domain and redesigned the web tool build process to reduce build time and complexity.

• Maintained legacy tools such as the binary packet logging system responsible for storing all point data reported by devices into Mongo databases and making it accessible through an internal web tool. Improved Mongo performance to support writing ~180 million objects per day.

• Improved development process by reducing Continuous Integration server build time by a factor of 20 with Ruby scripts. Reduced overall release process time by automating multiple steps with a Node.js app and various API integrations (TeamCity, Kiln, JIRA, Google drive).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a User Acceptance Test environment for the unit servers to avoid introducing regressions when transfering staging into production. Backend was built in C# and UI was built using AngularJS and Bootstrap.

• Prepared internal package for public distribution and published telogis-tde to the NPM registry.

• Built a web tool to generate configuration scripts for Xirgo devices. Tool uses MEAN stack.

• Worked on a system to recover non-reporting units through SMS and existing communication channels. Built with C#, Node, and Node-Red.

positions.title: IT Specialist/Project Manager Assistant
positions.description: Oversee all technology equipment and configurations. Assist the project manager of a construction company in planning, executing and closing of various projects by building and following the project requirements while managing the constraints such as time, cost, and scope of work.

positions.title: Java EE Instructor
positions.description: Planned and designed the curriculum that would be taught to prospective students over a course of 5 weeks in 4-hour days. The curriculum being taught included topics such as Java SE/EE, xHTML, mySQL, AJAX, jQuery, and CSS. Performed final student evaluation and determined who passed into the second stage of the training.
